input-field.name: enableOrderExport
input-field.label: Send orders to Minimax
Aufträge an Minimax senden
input-field.helpText: Off by default. While off, the export still runs and logs the exact payload it would send, using read-only lookups only: nothing is created in Minimax, a customer that does not exist yet is listed as "WouldCreate".

input-field.name: shippingItemCode
input-field.label: Minimax item for shipping costs (code or name)
Minimax-Artikel für Versandkosten (Code oder Name)
input-field.helpText: Code or exact name of the Minimax item every shipping row points to. A Minimax order row carries no VAT rate of its own — it inherits it from the referenced item. Leave empty for "POŠTNINA". Which orders are exported is fixed: order state "Open"; card / online payments only once paid; cash on delivery, invoice and prepayment right away.
